--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}

--- source_prologue ---
// A 3D recursive tree. One call draws one limb as a tapered pentagonal
// tube, caps the joint with a knuckle sphere, walks to the tip, and
// forks into three children 120 degrees apart -- so the whole
// trunk-to-twig structure is the same few lines applied at five scales.
static float depth = 4; // @tune
static float len = 2.1; // @tune
static float rad = 0.26; // @tune
static float randSeed = 0.31; // @tune

limb(depth, len, rad, seed) {
  float u, rtop, s, side, w;
  // Top radius matches the children's base radius, so the joints meet.
  rtop = rad*0.7;
  // Bark (a dimmed CORAL) at the trunk, foliage TEAL out at the twigs.
  u = pow((4 - depth)*0.25, 2.2);
  glColor3f(lerp(0.26, 0.16, u), lerp(0.13, 0.80, u), lerp(0.09, 0.70, u));
  glBegin(GL_QUAD_STRIP);
    for(i, 0, 6) {
      glNormal3f(cos(i*TAU/5), 0.3, sin(i*TAU/5));
      glVertex3f(rad*cos(i*TAU/5), 0, rad*sin(i*TAU/5));
      glVertex3f(rtop*cos(i*TAU/5), len, rtop*sin(i*TAU/5));
    }
  glEnd();
  glTranslatef(0, len, 0);
  glutSolidSphere(rtop, 6, 4);
  // Base case vs recursive case as a complementary if pair (an if/else):
  // depth 0 caps the twig with a leaf cluster, otherwise it forks.
  if(depth <= 0) {
    // Three flattened blades per twig, fanned around it. Their tint
    // slides TEAL -> AZURE with the twig's own rand(), so the canopy
    // reads as many leaves rather than one repeated one.
    w = rand(seed + 7, 0);
    glColor3f(lerp(0.10, 0.15, w), lerp(0.95, 0.72, w), lerp(0.85, 1.00, w));
    for(j, 0, 3) {
      glPushMatrix();
        glRotatef(120*j + seed*140, 0, 1, 0);
        glRotatef(46, 0, 0, 1);
        glTranslatef(0, rad*2.1, 0);
        glScalef(1.3, 0.4, 1.3);
        glutSolidSphere(rad*1.8, 6, 4);
      glPopMatrix();
    }
  }
  if(depth > 0) {
    for(i, 0, 3) {
      // rand() keeps the three children from being clones: each gets its
      // own length and spread, stable per limb because the seed is.
      s = rand(seed + i);
      // Child 0 is the leader -- near-vertical and long, so the trunk
      // keeps climbing; 1 and 2 are the side limbs that swing out.
      side = min(i, 1);
      glPushMatrix();
        glRotatef(137.5*i + seed*95, 0, 1, 0);
        glRotatef(9 + 26*side + 15*s + (5 - depth)*1.5*sin(t*1.1 + seed*3 + i), 0, 0, 1);
        limb(depth - 1, len*(0.78 - 0.2*side + 0.1*s), rtop, seed + i*0.37 + 0.11);
      glPopMatrix();
    }
  }
}

  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);

  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);

  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 18);

  glRotatef(sin(t*0.3)*4, 0, 0, 1);
  limb(depth, len, rad, randSeed);
